
1. Unified Firefly Architecture & Tech Stack

[ Edge API Gateway (Adobe API Mesh) ]
                │
                ▼ (Scope & Token Validation)
[ Ingestion & Async Choreography Bus (Kafka + Adobe I/O Runtime) ]
        │                                 │
        ▼ (Generative Tasks)              ▼ (Canvas Actions)
[ Firefly Engine (PyTorch/GPU clusters) ] [ Headless CC Orchestrator (C++ / WASM Engine) ]
• API Gateway & Edge Mesh: Adobe API Mesh (GraphQL + Reverse Proxy routing layers).
• Choreography & Async Event Hub: Kafka cluster handling task distribution. Adobe I/O Runtime (Serverless Node.js infrastructure) capturing lifecycle tracking records.
• Generative AI Pipeline: Python execution framework leveraging PyTorch clusters with custom CUDA scaling architectures for v2/v3 diffusion model evaluations.
• Canvas Orchestration Engine: Native C++ codebase compiled down into automated service layers running within containerized headless configurations (Photoshop/Lightroom instances).

2. Comprehensive cURL Request Breakdowns


A. Identity Generation (Token Fetch Pass)

bash
curl -X POST https://adobelogin.com \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "grant_type=client_credentials" \
  -d "client_id=YOUR_FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID" \
  -d "client_secret=YOUR_FIREFLY_CLIENT_SECRET" \
  -d "scope=openid,AdobeID,read_organizations,firefly_enterprise,firefly_api,ff_apis"
Use code with caution.

B. Generative Text-to-Image (v3 Asynchronous Engine)

bash
curl -X POST https://adobe.io \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "numVariations": 4,
    "prompt": "Minimalist sleek smartphone placed on a glossy marble workspace, dramatic volumetric lighting, cinematic presentation",
    "aspectRatio": "16:9",
    "imageStyles": {
      "styles": ["photo", "hyper_realistic"]
    },
    "contentClass": "photo"
  }'
Use code with caution.

C. Asynchronous Task Lifecycle Tracker (Polling)

bash
curl -X GET https://adobe.io \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID"
Use code with caution.

D. Generative Fill & Inpainting (v1 Core Engine)

bash
curl -X POST https://adobe.io \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_FIREFLY_CLIENT_ID" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "prompt": "An elegant white porcelain coffee mug, steaming hot coffee",
    "image": {
      "source": { "url": "https://amazonaws.com" },
      "mask": { "url": "https://amazonaws.com" }
    }
  }'
Use code with caution.

3. System Invariant Triggers & Event Model Schema

Adobe Firefly Service tracking passes emit JSON-structured webhook operations when asynchronous worker queues complete tasks.
json
{
  "id": "evt_abc12377fd8831a",
  "source": "/firefly/services/engine",
  "specversion": "1.0",
  "type": "com.adobe.firefly.job.completed",
  "datacontenttype": "application/json",
  "time": "2026-11-01T21:48:10.003Z",
  "data": {
    "jobId": "job_01jbf88319aa51c2",
    "status": "SUCCEEDED",
    "tenantId": "tnt_enterprise_99312b",
    "metrics": {
      "executionTimeMs": 4218,
      "gpuComputeUnits": 1.25,
      "currencyType": "FIREFLY_GENERATIVE_CREDITS"
    },
    "outputs": [
      {
        "id": "img_v3_var_0",
        "url": "https://amazonaws.com",
        "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
        "fileSize": 1845102,
        "sha256": "sha256:e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855"
      }
    ]
  }
}
Use code with caution.

4. Relational Taxonomy Schema (SQL / Prisma Ecosystem)

This layout tracks structural job states, model variations, and credits across a multi-tenant enterprise system.
prisma
datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model OrganizationWorkspace {
  id              String         @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  adobeOrgId      String         @unique @map("adobe_org_id")
  name            String         @db.VarChar(255)
  createdAt       DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  
  fireflyJobs     FireflyJob[]
  creditLedgers   CreditLedger[]

  @@map("organization_workspaces")
}

model FireflyJob {
  id              String         @id @map("id") // Maps to Adobe internal Job ID string
  workspaceId     String         @db.Uuid @map("workspace_id")
  engineCategory  EngineCategory @map("engine_category")
  actionType      String         @map("action_type") // e.g. "TEXT_TO_IMAGE", "GENERATIVE_FILL"
  status          JobStatus      @default(RUNNING)
  promptPayload   String         @db.Text @map("prompt_payload")
  errorMessage    String?        @db.Text @map("error_message")
  createdAt       DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime       @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  workspace       OrganizationWorkspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  outputs         JobOutput[]

  @@index([workspaceId, status])
  @@map("firefly_jobs")
}

model JobOutput {
  id              String         @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  jobId           String         @map("job_id")
  cdnUrl          String         @db.Text @map("cdn_url")
  fileSize        Int            @map("file_size")
  checksumSha256  String         @map("checksum_sha256")
  createdAt       DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  job             FireflyJob     @relation(fields: [jobId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("job_outputs")
}

model CreditLedger {
  id              String         @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  workspaceId     String         @db.Uuid @map("workspace_id")
  amountDebited   Decimal        @db.Decimal(10, 4) @map("amount_debited")
  referenceJobId  String?        @map("reference_job_id")
  createdAt       DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  workspace       OrganizationWorkspace @relation(fields: [workspaceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([workspaceId])
  @@map("credit_ledgers")
}

enum EngineCategory {
  FIREFLY_GENERATIVE
  PHOTOSHOP_HEADLESS
  LIGHTROOM_HEADLESS
  ILLUSTRATOR_VECTOR
}

enum JobStatus {
  RUNNING
  SUCCEEDED
  FAILED
  CANCELLED
}
Use code with caution.
